description: Non-authoritative source hint catalog for LLM documentation work. These hints are shortcuts for finding likely documentation locations, not a registry of verified sources. Agents and maintainers must verify each repository, path, version, and format before use.

sources.name: Supabase SDK Documentation
sources.description: OpenRef YAML specifications for all Supabase client SDK libraries across multiple programming languages
sources.hint: Likely OpenRef specs live under apps/docs/spec. Verify the exact SDK/version file exists before using the current configured-SDK CLI workflow.

sources.name: The Swift Programming Language
sources.description: Official Swift programming language documentation in Apple's DocC format. Comprehensive guide covering Swift syntax, language features, and best practices.

sections.name: LanguageGuide
sections.description: Comprehensive guide to Swift language features

sources.hint: Likely DocC-flavored Markdown lives under TSPL.docc. Verify the current repository layout before parsing files with the Markdown/DocC parser modules.

sources.name: Python Documentation
sources.description: Official Python language documentation covering the standard library, language reference, and tutorials
sources.hint: Likely reStructuredText docs live under Doc. This is a hint only; RST parsing is not implemented yet.

sources.name: TypeScript Handbook
sources.hint: Likely Markdown docs live at the repository root. Verify the current repository layout before use.
sources.note: Requires testing with current markdown parser

sources.name: The Rust Programming Language
sources.description: Official Rust programming language book (The Book)
sources.hint: Likely Markdown book sources live under src. Verify the current repository layout before use.
sources.note: Requires testing with current markdown parser

contributing.message: To add or update a source hint, submit a PR with:
requirements: Add or update an entry in this JSON file with enough detail to verify the hint
Verify the repository, path, version, and format before marking tested: true
Do not treat this file as authoritative source discovery
Do not include unsupported current CLI commands as usage examples
